title: State Management with Redux Toolkit / Zustand
description: Explore modern state management in React using Redux Toolkit and Zustand for scalable and efficient app state handling.

lessons.title: Why State Management?
lessons.content: State management helps manage shared data and UI state across components, improving app organization and predictability.

lessons.title: Introduction to Redux Toolkit
lessons.content: Redux Toolkit is the official, opinionated Redux toolset that simplifies store setup, reducers, and actions with less boilerplate.

lessons.title: Setting Up Redux Toolkit
Creating a Slice with Redux Toolkit
Using Redux State in Components
Introduction to Zustand
lessons.content: Zustand is a lightweight and simple state management library that uses hooks and provides minimal boilerplate.

lessons.title: Setting Up Zustand Store
Using Zustand State in Components
Comparing Redux Toolkit and Zustand
lessons.content:
- Redux Toolkit: Powerful, great for large apps, has devtools and middleware support
- Zustand: Lightweight, minimal setup, great for simple to medium apps
Choose based on your app complexity.

lessons.title: Best Practices for State Management
lessons.content:
- Keep state minimal and focused
- Use appropriate tools for app size
- Keep UI and state logic separated
- Use middleware or async tools like RTK Query or React Query for async state
